# Spec: Put a message on a queue

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/queue-a-message.md)

**Start:** `/messaging/queues`  
**Persona:** A developer testing asynchronous processing  
**Goal:** Enqueue a message and find the event reference that describes the queue.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Write the message | The Enqueue button is enabled once input is entered. |
| 2 | Enqueue | The result shows status queued.<br>The event reference link points to the "all" AsyncAPI document. |
